in_hebrew.name: אדריאליס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדריאליס הוא שם המשלב את השורשים העבריים 'אדר' ו'אל' ו'יס', המתארים את עוזרו של האלוהים, מלמד ומדריך בדרכיו. השם מביע את האמון באלוהים כמורה ומדריך בחיים.

in_greek.name: Αδριελίς
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αδριελίς προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές ρίζες 'αδρός' και 'ελ', που συμβολίζουν τη δύναμη και τη βοήθεια του Θεού. Στην πνευματική παράδοση, το όνομα αντιπροσωπεύει τη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού, ως οδηγός και βοηθός.

in_latin.name: Adrielis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Adrielis ex radicibus Latinis 'ad' et 'riel' et 'is' derivatur, quae auxilium et doctrinam Dei exprimunt. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc significat fidem in Deum ut ductorem et adiutorem in vita.

in_english.name: Adrielis
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adrielis is derived from Hebrew roots 'Adar' and 'El' and 'Is', signifying God's help and guidance. In Christian tradition, Adrielis represents trust in God as a guide and helper in life, embodying spiritual values of faith and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Adrielis is rooted in the rich heritage of the Christian faith. It carries the powerful message of divine assistance and illumination. The name may evoke images of St. Adrien, the patron saint of sailors, who is believed to protect and guide those who navigate the seas. In a wider cultural context, Adrielis may be a reminder of the comforting presence of God in times of uncertainty or need.
data.spiritual_significance: Adrielis is a name that speaks directly to the core of one's faith. It implies a deep trust in the providential care of God, who is both a helper (as expressed in the Hebrew name Adriel, which means "God is my help") and a source of light (as expressed in the Greek form of the name, Adelphos, which means "noble, precious, or belonging to one's brother," evoking the image of Christ as the Light of the World). Adrielis embodies the comforting reality that God is always with us, guiding us through the challenges of life and illuminating our path to salvation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Adrielis: Divine strength and hidden wisdom. A name for those seeking guidance and protection in their spiritual journey.
